mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEVICE (device_name, device_type, model, serial_number, output_channels, max_resolution, base_url) VALUES (#{device.deviceName}, #{device.deviceType}, #{device.model}, #{device.serialNumber}, #{device.outputChannels}, #{device.maxResolution}, #{baseUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE DEVICE SET enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE DEVICE SET online = #{online}, last_heartbeat = #{lastHeartbeat}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE DEVICE SET device_name = #{device.deviceName}, device_type = #{device.deviceType}, model = #{device.model}, serial_number = #{device.serialNumber}, output_channels = #{device.outputChannels}, max_resolution = #{device.maxResolution}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_name, device_type, model, serial_number, output_channels, max_resolution, base_url, online, enabled FROM DEVICE WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, device_name, device_type, model, serial_number, output_channels, max_resolution, base_url, online, enabled FROM DEVICE WHERE base_url = #{baseUrl}
SELECT id, device_name, device_type, model, serial_number, output_channels, max_resolution, base_url, online, enabled FROM DEVICE ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, device_name, device_type, model, serial_number, output_channels, max_resolution, base_url, online, enabled FROM DEVICE
AND device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
AND device_type = #{deviceType}
ORDER BY id DESC
